title: Lookingglass Theatre
subtitle: Ensemble theatre company, Chicago
summary: A full site build for one of Chicago's most iconic ensemble theatre companies. I worked across the whole thing — WordPress CMS, scroll-driven animations, and a drag carousel for the productions. The most interesting challenge was integrating a full calendar system that could surface the right events contextually for each individual play, keeping complex scheduling logic from leaking into the user experience.

title: Wing
subtitle: Drone delivery marketing surfaces
summary: I built this one from scratch in Framer, contributing across most of the site. The most interesting challenge was a custom PNG sequence system — binding frame-by-frame image sequences to component state so animations could respond dynamically to interaction, not just play on loop.

title: Thick Pickle
subtitle: Brand-first product site for a creative studio
summary: A creative studio site that already looked great — my job was to wire it to life. I handled the full Shopify integration: cart logic, product selection, and all the commerce flows, making sure the transactional layer felt as polished as the visual design.

title: Octaura
subtitle: Headless commerce, financial UI
summary: A headless financial platform where the design language lived in motion. I was responsible for the scroll-bound animations throughout the site — sequences that had to feel precise and intentional, not decorative, given the enterprise audience.

title: Swisher Blunts
subtitle: Immersive multimedia brand experience
summary: A brand experience built to feel tactile. I worked on scroll-driven video sequences, flavor reveal animations, an interactive audio layer, and the age-gate flow — all of it choreographed to make the site feel more like a product than a page.

title: Aerika Estate
subtitle: Ultra-premium Napa Valley wine estate
summary: A luxury wine estate site where every detail had to feel considered. I built it pixel-perfect and mobile-first on WordPress with Commerce 7, including a private membership flow that needed to match the refinement of the brand itself.

title: Appfire
subtitle: Enterprise SaaS marketing at scale
summary: Enterprise scale, real performance pressure. This site serves 25,000+ customers and a majority of the Fortune 500. I worked across almost all the animations and interactions on the site, and also handled the configuration and mapping for the Typesense search integration — keeping everything sharp on a Next.js + GraphQL stack while staying top-decile on Core Web Vitals.

title: Qrypt
subtitle: Quantum-secure encryption, NYC
summary: My focus was the homepage — building it as an experience rather than a page. I combined scroll, WebGL, and Three.js into a single cohesive animation that gives weight to what quantum encryption actually feels like, not just what it is.

title: Just Women's Sports
subtitle: Women's sports media & live scores platform
summary: A full site build for one of the leading women's sports media platforms. I worked across the whole stack — WordPress CMS, animations, and performance — but the most technically demanding part was building the scores and schedules system. Pulling and displaying real-time data across multiple leagues (WNBA, NWSL, USWNT, WTA and more) while keeping the site fast under heavy traffic was the core challenge. High content volume, live data, and performance all had to coexist.
